kurzbeschreibung:
**

Welcome to Ellmau

** **

Discover the magic of the Tirol Alps in Ellmau – a charming village nestled in the heart of the Zillertal, just a short drive from Innsbruck. Whether you're seeking adventure, relaxation, or authentic Tiroler hospitality, Ellmau promises unforgettable experiences for every season.

** **

Winter Wonderland

** **

Ellmau is a paradise for winter sports enthusiasts. The Ellmau-Zillertal ski area offers over 100 km of perfectly groomed slopes, from gentle beginner runs to thrilling off-piste terrain. After a day on the slopes, warm up with a hearty Tiroler Gröstl or a creamy Kaiserschmarrn at one of our cozy mountain huts.

** **

Summer Adventures

** **

When the snow melts, Ellmau transforms into a haven for hikers, mountain bikers, and nature lovers. Explore the stunning Zillertal trails, take a dip in the refreshing Zillertal lakes, or enjoy a scenic gondola ride to the top of the Ahornspitze. Don’t miss the chance to taste local specialties like Schlutzkrapfen or Käsespätzle at a traditional Tiroler farm.

** **

Culture & Traditions

** **

Immerse yourself in Tiroler culture with visits to historic villages, craft workshops, and lively festivals. Experience the warmth of Gemütlichkeit in our rustic Gasthöfe, where you can enjoy live Almhüttenmusik and sample regional wines and beers.

** **

Wellness & Relaxation

** **

Unwind in one of Ellmau’s luxurious wellness spas, where you can soak in thermal baths, enjoy massages, or simply relax with a view of the majestic Zillertaler Alpen. Afterward, treat yourself to a gourmet dinner featuring the finest Tiroler ingredients.

** **

Family-Friendly Fun

** **

Ellmau is the perfect destination for families. Kids will love the Zillertal Arena, with its gentle slopes and fun sledding hills. Families can also enjoy shared activities like horse-drawn carriage rides, visits to local farms, or storytelling sessions in traditional Tiroler costumes.

** **

Get Here & Stay

** **

Ellmau is easily accessible by car or public transport from Innsbruck (about 1 hour). The village offers a variety of accommodations, from cozy Berghütten to modern hotels and family-friendly apartments. Whether you're planning a short getaway or a longer stay, Ellmau promises an authentic Tirol experience you’ll cherish forever.

** **

Plan Your Visit

** **

Ready to explore? Check out our events calendar, ski passes, and hiking trails to start planning your adventure in Ellmau today!

**
